what: Six photo blocks of different sizes, blur and tilt are scattered on screen and rotate one slot every 5 seconds (tilt and position 1s, size 1.5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)). The block that reaches the center expands to fill the board after .6s, straightens its tilt, lays down that block’s color background and a 30% dark photo overlay, then folds back after 3.2s. The name tag, progress bar (one loop, linear), number and prev/next buttons advance along with it.

options.interval: Slide interval (ms), default 5000 — the progress bar also fills over this length
options.start: Time until the first slide (ms), default 1000 (original: start marker shows .5s after the page opens, first slide .5s later)
options.zoom-delay: Time from flip until it unfolds (ms), default 600
options.--fx-color: Background color applied when each chunk unfolds (via style), default accent color — if transparent, only the photo cell unfolds with no background (for nca, the back panel color changes via [data-orbit-at] to produce the course color)
options.--fx-radius: Photo box corner radius, default 30px (tablet 12px · phone 4px — --fx-radius-tab · --fx-radius-sp)
options.[data-fx-part=block]: Chunks (children, up to six) — inside [data-fx-part=grid] Photo cells in a 2×2 grid
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Label for each chunk (in order) — is-active when its turn comes
options.[data-fx-part=bar]: Slot for as many progress bar cells as there are chunks (press to jump to that chunk)

note: The original is CSS transitions driven by setInterval and setTimeout, so it was ported as is. If the number of chunks is not six, the spare slots stay empty, and any extra chunks need more [data-pos] rules in css.
